request.text:
A: Because the ground is cooling. Our ember, the piece of the Hearthflame under the ford, is going out. I've known for six years.
<long pause>
A: Here's two hundred gold as an advance. Come down to the bridge end with me and see what we're up against.
<long pause>
B: <Elderly goblin matriarch: low female contralto, husky dry rasp and age-creak; measured, wary, quietly commanding, with tired warmth. Mood: idle.> Hm. Well fought. My grandson Vorga always said the valley would never share. I should have listened to him.
